テキスト cha 900: Born May 26. Height 170cm (as of Shiyo 1). At the time, third son of the Emperor three reigns back. He issues "the Prince's decree," urging the Minato clan to raise an army to overthrow the Tara clan. In April of Shiyo 1, resolved to strike down the Tara clan, the Prince follows the advice of Minato no Tsunamune's grandfather and issues a decree to hunt down the Tara clan to the Minato clan, who lie low across the land, urging them to raise an army and rise up in arms to overthrow the Tara clan, but he is defeated. History says he was executed after this battle, but by one theory he fled east and survived. It is he who founded the Arata settlement, and he is the ancestor of the Niimura family. In other words, the Niimura family is a line directly descended from the Emperor, but in Shiyo 800 no one knows it.

Sure of the Arata settlement's prosperity, and to save people suffering hardship across the land, he sets out on a journey alone. But Minato no Tsunamune sees that his true purpose is to tear himself away from his feelings for Ito. As he leaves, he gives Ito a hairpin and promises to come for her in 10 years, but he is killed in the land of Motoki by remnants of the Tara clan. His remains rest beneath the goshinboku of Motoki-cho.
